user.title: Generic Video Proxy
user.description: Home Assistant fetches this stream and re-serves it from its own address, so the video plays in the web UI over http or https, at home and from outside.

data_description.url: Example: http://192.168.1.10:8080/video for an MJPEG stream, https://example.com/live/index.m3u8 for HLS, or a direct image URL.
data_description.source_type: Detect automatically identifies the stream from the upstream Content-Type when you save.
data_description.auth_type: HTTP authentication used by the upstream device, if any.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for devices with a self-signed certificate.
data_description.snapshot_url: Optional JPEG endpoint used for the camera image. Needed for HLS or MP4 sources that have no still image.
data_description.poster_url: Optional image shown before the video starts.
data_description.headers: One header per line, for example: X-Api-Key: my-token
data_description.scan_interval: How often a still image source is polled, in seconds.
data_description.reconnect_interval: Delay before reconnecting after a failure, in seconds.
data_description.upstream_timeout: Timeout for connecting to the source, in seconds.
data_description.stall_timeout: Close the connection when no data arrives for this many seconds.
data_description.frame_buffer: How many frames are buffered per viewer.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the stream. Check the URL, the credentials and that the source is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_config: The configuration is not valid. Check the URL and the advanced values; see the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: Generic Video Proxy
init.description: Update the source, credentials and tuning of this proxy.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
data_description.headers: One header per line, for example: X-Api-Key: my-token
